question: Are the v6 landscape stalls regressions caused by the exact candidate, or baseline outcomes of the same sampled policies and seeds?

competingOptions.statement: Candidate stalls are a subset of paired live stalls, simulator errors remain zero, and all route gates reproduce.
At least one candidate stall is not a stall for the paired live policy and seed, or an error occurs.

estimands.reliability: Paired candidate-minus-live added stalls by policy, aspect, vow and seed; any added stall or simulator error fails.
estimands.reachability: Legacy rewards acquire, play and activate both components for at least two distinct policies per applicable aspect/vow and split.
estimands.policyViability: Each route has at least two witness policies whose full-seed win rate exceeds paired-split RandomBuild arm 2 by at least 0.35.
estimands.retention: Both route best-policy rates per grid are within 0.10 and their witness sets differ.
estimands.vow5: Every top route-policy win rate is at most 0.90.

successRule.reliability: No candidate-added stall and zero candidate/live simulator errors.
successRule.reachability: Both packages per aspect meet the policy witness rule in every grid and split.
successRule.c2: RandomBuild arm 2 is below 0.50 and both route endpoints have at least two policies with a gap of at least 0.35.
successRule.retention: Both route endpoints remain within 0.10 of the top and use distinct witness sets.
successRule.vow5: Every top route-policy win rate is at most 0.90.

cheapestDiscriminatingExperiment: Run paired candidate/live 64-policy by 8-seed discovery landscapes. Extend the same cohort to 128 by 16 only if route evidence is underpowered and no added reliability fault is present.
inconclusiveRule: A non-fault route shortfall at the first look extends to the frozen maximum. At the maximum it rejects. No candidate, policy logic or estimand changes.
stopRule: Reject immediately on a candidate-added stall or any simulator error. Detector mutations remain forbidden until discovery and independent validation landscapes pass.
